summary: `--team-id` query flags are strings passed through verbatim, not float64.
reason: The spec types team_id as `number`; the generator made it float64 and serialized it with %v, so any 7-digit workspace id went out in scientific notation (e.g. 1.234567e+06) and the API answered 400 SHARD_024 `Invalid workspace id`. Applies to every command taking --team-id with --custom-task-ids.
validated_outcome: `task get <custom_id> --custom-task-ids --team-id <ws>` returned 400 before and the task after; --dry-run shows team_id unchanged.
